reflective.en: The reflective surface made the room appear brighter in daylight.
reflective.zh: 反光表面讓房間在白天看起來更明亮。

reform.en: The report proposes reform of the outdated school policy.
reform.zh: 這份報告建議改革過時的校規。

refuge.en: The hikers found refuge from the rain inside a shelter.
refuge.zh: 健行者在避難小屋裡躲雨。

refugee.en: The article describes how a refugee family rebuilt its life abroad.
refugee.zh: 文章描述一個難民家庭如何在海外重新建立生活。

refund.en: The store issued a refund after the damaged item was returned.
refund.zh: 商品損壞退回後，商店辦理了退款。

refusal.en: His refusal to explain the change confused the whole group.
refusal.zh: 他拒絕解釋這項改變，讓整個小組感到困惑。

refuse.en: Students may refuse to join an optional activity without penalty.
refuse.zh: 學生可以拒絕參加非必選活動，而不受處分。

refute.en: The researcher used new evidence to refute the earlier claim.
refute.zh: 研究者用新證據反駁先前的主張。

regarding.en: The teacher sent a message regarding tomorrow's schedule change.
regarding.zh: 老師傳了一則關於明日時程變更的訊息。

regardless.en: Everyone must follow the rule regardless of their grade level.
regardless.zh: 無論年級，每個人都必須遵守這項規定。

regime.en: The history class examined how the old regime maintained authority.
regime.zh: 歷史課探討舊政權如何維持統治。

regional.en: The regional competition brought together students from several cities.
regional.zh: 區域競賽讓來自多個城市的學生齊聚一堂。

register.en: Students must register online before joining the workshop.
register.zh: 學生參加工作坊前必須先在網路上登記。

registration.en: Registration for the science camp closes at the end of May.
registration.zh: 科學營報名將在五月底截止。

regret.en: She felt regret after missing the chance to apologize.
regret.zh: 錯過道歉的機會後，她感到後悔。

regulation.en: The new regulation requires clearer labels on school equipment.
regulation.zh: 新規定要求學校設備使用更清楚的標示。

rehabilitate.en: The city plans to rehabilitate the old riverside park.
rehabilitate.zh: 市府計畫整修老舊的河濱公園。

rehearsal.en: The cast attended a final rehearsal before opening night.
rehearsal.zh: 演員們在首演前參加最後一次彩排。

rehearse.en: The group stayed after school to rehearse its presentation.
rehearse.zh: 小組放學後留下來排練簡報。

reign.en: The museum exhibit covers the king's reign and major reforms.
reign.zh: 博物館展覽介紹那位國王的統治時期與重大改革。

reject.en: The committee may reject a proposal that lacks supporting evidence.
reject.zh: 缺乏佐證的提案可能會被委員會否決。

rejection.en: The rejection encouraged her to improve the application and try again.
rejection.zh: 這次被拒反而鼓勵她改進申請內容並再次嘗試。

rejoice.en: Fans began to rejoice when the final result was announced.
rejoice.zh: 最終結果公布時，支持者開始歡呼慶祝。

relate.en: The teacher asked us to relate the story to our own experience.
relate.zh: 老師要我們把故事和自己的經驗連結起來。

relaxation.en: Reading quietly can be a form of relaxation after school.
relaxation.zh: 放學後安靜閱讀可以是一種放鬆方式。

relay.en: The team practiced passing the baton for the relay race.
relay.zh: 隊伍為接力賽練習交接棒。

relentless.en: The relentless rain continued throughout most of the afternoon.
relentless.zh: 持續不斷的雨幾乎下了一整個下午。

reliance.en: Too much reliance on one source can weaken a research report.
reliance.zh: 過度依賴單一來源可能削弱研究報告的可信度。

reliant.en: The system is reliant on a stable internet connection.
reliant.zh: 這套系統仰賴穩定的網路連線。

relic.en: The museum displayed a relic discovered near the ancient temple.
relic.zh: 博物館展示一件在古寺附近發現的文物。

relieve.en: A short break can relieve some pressure during a long study session.
relieve.zh: 長時間讀書時短暫休息可以減輕一些壓力。

religion.en: The course examines religion as part of history and culture.
religion.zh: 這門課把宗教視為歷史與文化的一部分來探討。

religious.en: The museum includes objects from several religious traditions.
religious.zh: 博物館收藏來自多種宗教傳統的物件。

remainder.en: We used the first hour for discussion and the remainder for writing.
remainder.zh: 我們第一個小時用來討論，其餘時間用來寫作。

remark.en: Her thoughtful remark changed the direction of the discussion.
remark.zh: 她深思熟慮的一句話改變了討論方向。

reminiscent.en: The melody is reminiscent of traditional songs from the region.
reminiscent.zh: 這段旋律讓人想起該地區的傳統歌曲。

remote.en: The research team visited a remote village in the mountains.
remote.zh: 研究團隊造訪了一座偏遠山村。

removal.en: The removal of damaged branches made the path safer.
removal.zh: 移除受損樹枝後，步道變得更安全。

renew.en: Students can renew borrowed books through the library website.
renew.zh: 學生可以透過圖書館網站續借書籍。

renowned.en: A renowned scientist gave a lecture at the university.
renowned.zh: 一位知名科學家在大學舉行演講。

rent.en: Visitors can rent bicycles near the park entrance.
rent.zh: 遊客可以在公園入口附近租借自行車。

rental.en: The rental fee includes basic equipment and a storage locker.
rental.zh: 租借費包含基本設備和置物櫃。

repair.en: The technician completed the repair before the computer class began.
repair.zh: 技術人員在電腦課開始前完成維修。

repay.en: He promised to repay the borrowed money by Friday.
repay.zh: 他答應在週五前歸還借來的錢。

represent.en: These three examples represent the most common responses in the survey.
represent.zh: 這三個例子代表調查中最常見的回答。

representation.en: The chart gives a clear representation of changes over time.
representation.zh: 這張圖清楚呈現了隨時間發生的變化。

representative.en: Each class chose one representative to attend the student meeting.
representative.zh: 每班選出一名代表參加學生會議。

reproduce.en: Scientists must be able to reproduce results under similar conditions.
reproduce.zh: 科學家必須能在相似條件下重現結果。

reptile.en: The biology exhibit explains how a reptile regulates body temperature.
reptile.zh: 生物展覽說明爬蟲類如何調節體溫。

republic.en: The textbook explains how a republic chooses its political leaders.
republic.zh: 課本說明共和國如何選出政治領導人。
